critical.evidence: The alternate sealed entry validates caller-provided descriptor paths and hashes but does not independently bind all four script descriptors to candidate Git objects or require their full seal masks. A bounded no-engine check reached attempt creation with a non-candidate cgroup descriptor.
critical.affected_gate: W7.1 production-path integrity and measurement validity
critical.acceptance_test: Every alternate-entry script descriptor must be fully sealed and byte-equal to candidate:path under an independently resolved candidate before attempt creation; unsealed, differently sealed, or byte-different descriptors must fail.

high.evidence: Terminating the seal holder after attempt creation made the finalizer unable to load the sealed scorer. The run exited 125 with containment files but without the required evidence triplet.
high.affected_gate: W7.1 failure preservation and evidence contract

high.evidence: An exact-byte but unsealed writable memfd was accepted by the alternate harness entry because that path checked its shape and digest but not F_GET_SEALS.
high.affected_gate: W7.1 runtime-input immutability, scorer authority, and false-PASS resistance
high.acceptance_test: Require the exact full seal mask for all four script descriptors at every alternate entry and add separate exact-byte/unsealed negative tests.
